verdict.rationale: Synthesia publishes a first-party API reference at docs.synthesia.io/reference. It covers the Video, Upload, Billing and Localization APIs and includes a quickstart that walks through creating videos, using webhooks and downloading results. The docs are also machine-readable via an llms.txt file. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in-browser. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
